title: Find things with comparable
hints: `comparable` is exactly what allows `x == target`. With `T any` the same code wouldn't compile.
`IndexOf`: `for i, x := range xs { if x == target { return i } }`, then `return -1` after the loop. `LastIndexOf` walks backwards: `for i := len(xs) - 1; i >= 0; i--`.
`Contains` is one line: `return IndexOf(xs, target) >= 0` (inference picks `T` for you). `Count` keeps `n := 0` and does `n++` on every match.
